discovery_notes: DLR 2017 LE/LR leads from search snippets only (29 standard WebSearch calls, blocked domains excluded). Dominated by Disney Pins Blog weekly roundups and event posts; WDWNT, WDWInfo, ITM, Mickey News also used. Shared DL+WDW releases (Facilier, Slave I, Headless Horseman, mystery sets) included because snippets name Disneyland. Reseller listings (ecrater, distradingpins4u, yourwdwstore, magicalears) ignored. Several per-outlet attributions come from blended search summaries and are flagged in not_found. No members invented; no sets split by character without a source naming the pin.
